summary: Through-road kerb with no parking except by houses 1-8 m away.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked along most of it
Houses 1-8 m from kerb where cars park
No Stopping signs at the start

best_section.where: Indooroopilly Road west kerb, beside the wooded lot north of the large red-roofed house

drivers.seclusion: Wooded lot on the west with houses 15 m or more off this section, but homes hard against the kerb elsewhere.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow verge and footpath behind the kerb; no parked cars or marked parking lane on the through road here.
drivers.traffic: Through route with centre line markings and steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this stretch; only a few parked near the start by the houses.

flags: Main road with no parking along the best section
Dwellings 1-8 m from kerb near the start
No Stopping Any Time signs at the start
Slope about 6%, steep, up to 35% locally
Low-lying, 10-18 m elevation, unnamed waterway 60 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the west side; the road is open to the east and afternoon sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the road is signed no-parking
